newsitem.title: RUSSIA: RUSSIA'S MICEX JOINS WORK ON DEPOSITARY SYSTEM.
newsitem.headline: RUSSIA'S MICEX JOINS WORK ON DEPOSITARY SYSTEM.

text.p: Russia's leading currency and government securities exchange, the Moscow Interbank Currency Exchange (MICEX), said on Tuesday it would join efforts to create a unified depositary system for national capital markets.

MICEX, which also trades liquid shares in a few of Russia's biggest companies, joins the Russian Trading System, where most corporate stock is traded, the St Petersburg Currency Exchange, the National Depositary Centre (NDC) and the Depositary Clearing Company (DKK), MICEX president Alexander Zakharov told a news conference.
Russia's securities markets have developed rapidly in the past few years, but much work remains to be done to build and streamline clumsy and inadequate infrastructure, analysts say.

MICEX has a depositary agreement with Russia's Uneximbank and uses the MICEX Auditing Chamber to clear deals, but the RTS does not require deals to be registered and is still working on a depositary agreement with the DKK, RTS head Dmitry Ponomaryov said.

Work on the problem, which has been delayed by a row over market regulation between the central bank and Federal Commission for the Securities Market, has restarted in the government, NDC director Galina Starodubtseva said.
But she said the date by which the president was due to sign a decree on the issue had passed several days ago.
Signatories of the agreement initiated in June by the NDC and DKK, played down fears the decree would interfere with work already done.
"In the end it (the system) will have to be formed on the ground," said Zakharov. "They will have to come to the professionals."
